title: The kb says which Claude Code parallel-work option fits which coordination need and what each shares or isolates
goal: Research with the kb tools first and the live docs for gaps, written as kb facts and gap entries through /kb-research: (1) Which Claude Code parallel-work option (subagents, agent view background sessions, worktrees, agent teams, dynamic workflows, cross-session messaging) fits which coordination need, and what does each share or isolate? (2) How does agent view isolate background sessions' file edits in worktrees, and what does worktree.bgIsolation change? (3) Which of these options reach sessions on several machines or cloud sessions, and which stay on one machine? (4) What do dynamic workflows hold that a subagent or skill does not, and when do the docs say to use one?
